about_the_game:
Apocalypse of the Universe

Genre: 2D Platformer Adventure

Story:

In Apocalypse of the Universe, players take on the role of an elven hero on a perilous quest to save his homeland from a demonic invasion.

Once a peaceful world bathed in the eternal glow of the moon, it is now torn apart by portals that unleash endless waves of demons. These gateways connect to dark realms and threaten to spread corruption and decay across every corner of the land.

The hero must defeat powerful bosses who control these portals. Only by destroying them can he seal the gateways, purify the land, and break the curse that shrouds his world in darkness.

Gameplay:

  • Platforming Adventure: Navigate through challenging levels filled with traps, obstacles, and enemies. Precision and timing are essential to survival.

  • Combat Mechanics: Wield unique weapons, including a magical bow, and unleash special abilities to defeat demonic foes. Collect power-ups to boost your speed, damage, and durability.

  • Boss Battles: Each corrupted region is guarded by a mighty boss. Defeating them is key to closing the portals and reclaiming the land.

  • Character Progression: Gather resources and items to upgrade your hero’s skills and attributes, preparing for greater threats and complex enemies.

Features:

  • Unique Art Style: Pixel art visuals with atmospheric, dark fantasy backgrounds that bring the world to life.

  • Strategic Power-Ups: Temporary buffs like speed boosts, enhanced damage, and defense to turn the tide in combat.

  • Story Elements: Discover lore fragments and cinematic cutscenes that uncover the hero’s past and the origins of the curse.

  • Challenging Puzzles & Hidden Paths: Explore each level thoroughly to uncover secrets and solve environmental puzzles for valuable rewards.

Objective:

Cleanse the elf’s homeland of demonic corruption by defeating all portal guardians and closing the gates. Restore peace and bring an end to the age of darkness cast by the eternal moon.

  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX12 (shader model 4.0) capabilities.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
